Cabinet Approves Major Road and Heritage Projects in Delhi and UP

The Union Cabinet has approved significant infrastructure and heritage preservation projects. These include road development worth ₹14,115 crore for Delhi and Uttar Pradesh, featuring a new tunnel and highway expansions. Additionally, the Delhi government has cleared schemes to preserve 75 heritage monuments, encouraging public and private adoption for restoration.
